scope: Completed frozen Stage1 SCORE_DEVELOPMENT review, plus prospective theory advice for an eight-operator partial-deployment quality screen.

undefined_family.root: DeepSeek L13 expert10 decode: nine hits in eight of the same forty prompts.
undefined_family.interpretation: Same predeclared sparse-route mechanism as original Stage0. Preserve all 560 comparisons and all draws; no prefill/model/path subset receives rescued simultaneous inference.

N120_descriptive_direction_only.definition: Counts of eight operators where factor error is lower than the fixed local baseline; not significance or whole-system dominance.
N120_descriptive_direction_only.meaning: The global full-input factor control is a real decode tradeoff; mixed/prefill VALID cannot predict decode ordering. Neither the conditional full-output bank nor its factors dominate all relevant dimensions from these results.

result_limits: This reuse of SCORE is development/exploratory even if a future analysis obtains defined intervals. Original Stage0 and this Stage1 family remain inconclusive under their frozen rules.
Learning behavior is phase dependent: some full-input G decode errors worsen from N80 to N120 despite mixed VALID improving. Neither convergence nor an intrinsic no-go follows.

The factor endpoints use smaller retained coefficient banks but add host work and, for native paths, a latent quantizer/input dependency. Zero NAND pages, logical MACs and pilot cache residency do not establish latency dominance.
No true downstream NLL/task or free-running quality was measured here. No valid new experimental failure or publication success is assigned.

prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.design_opinion: Support a new prospective same-round bounded deployment criterion for a concrete adopted configuration. Universal impossibility of all guarded variants is not required; the old inconclusive statistical results remain unchanged.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.reference: B_pilotcanonical replaces only the same eight operators by the frozen canonical expert functions, leaving other branches source GGUF. C_local/G/PE replace exactly those operators and run their own KV states and live routing. Also retain source GGUF as context for any hybrid-reference loss.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.instrumentation_closure: Before quality interpretation, establish replacement-disabled graph equivalence and canonical replacement API correctness, including unweighted expert outputs, live alpha/merge order, partial selections and unchanged branches. Do not infer correctness from old capture-only callbacks.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.freeze_before_fresh_data: Freeze exact candidate/operator models, primary configuration and failure unit, reference, prefix/rollout/token scoring rules, genuinely fresh non-TEST evaluation IDs, mutation coverage requirements, paired prompt uncertainty and finite hypothesis family. Any guard/tolerance/configuration tuned on these outcomes becomes development and needs another held-out assessment.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.quality_failure_rule: A valid concrete rule is a prespecified one-sided simultaneous lower confidence bound on delta NLL(C minus B) exceeding an explicit practical margin. For illustration, log(1.02) nats/token is a 2-percent PPL margin; this is a possible engineering budget, not a universal publication threshold, and must not be selected from the new results.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.metrics: Score common fresh ground-truth token positions for paired teacher-forced NLL while each model maintains its own affected hidden/KV trajectory. Free-running generation uses each model's own tokens and routes; token disagreement alone is not a task-quality failure metric. Report actual replacement exposure and phase/continuation coverage.
prospective_partial_quality_gate_opinion.bounded_classification: A material, statistically supported breach after numerical and data closure can be called failure of the adopted eight-operator deployment configuration under that frozen quality budget. It cannot be called failure of every guarded bank, all-routed canonical inference, all-layer deployment, or the entire method family. A pass merely authorizes further same-round study.
